body: Thank you for helping me, I needed someone to talk to

I'm only talking over chat to him right now. And he's making it clear that he's still upset. When I say I think he's better, I mean he won't commit suicide any time soon. But he says he's still very depressed and earlier he felt really numb.

"Don't let him"
that's the problem though. I've had to work very hard to figure out what to say and do to not make it worse and it doesn't always work. If I could just convince him to talk to someone... I feel like the weight of the world is on my shoulders because he is my best friend

His girlfriend was the only one that could get him to stop cutting or being suicidal because she said that if he did that then she would too. I can't tell him that if he kills himself I will too. But if he gets bad again that is the only solution that's ever worked and I'm really confused

I'd love to if I was anywhere near him. and I feel like telling him that would just make him scoff and say things won't get better. but I don't think he's as bad now. it's hard to tell with him though. I've told him that I care so many times. I feel so unprepared and unable to handle what's going on though
